title: Proposed study collaboration on SNAP25-related disorders

sentences.text: Invitation to discuss a research collaboration on SNAP25-related disorders
Dear Snap25 Foundation team, your foundation focuses on families affected by SNAP25 changes.
I am [name, role, institution], and I would welcome your thoughts on a study idea.
Published work suggests the mechanism is variant-specific: some variants act in a dominant-negative way, one appears to gain function, and a loss-of-function link is contested.
Simons Searchlight is recruiting and lists SNAP25, and the RARE-X programmes and the congenital muscle disease registry also include this condition.
A completed amifampridine trial studied congenital myasthenic syndromes.
Aminopyridines have only been tested in the laboratory, and could be the wrong direction for variants that increase release.
We would propose [study aim and design], shaped with families and run under ethics approval.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be willing to discuss the idea, and how your community might take part with proper consent?
We are not asking for any names, contact details or records of patients or families.
If this interests you, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
Thank you for your time and care for these families.
